pages.title: Standard Model Singularity
pages.text: Every quark flavour, every lepton, every force carrier and the Higgs, compressed past the point where they are separate particles. It hums with all the interactions at once. Small enough to vanish in the hand, it nevertheless feels as if it holds the entire periodic table in reserve.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I gave the Conceptual Singularity Compressor each generation of quarks, the leptons, the gauge bosons and the Higgs, and asked it to compress the zoo. The particles collapsed into a single point carrying the whole Standard Model.
